description: Every follow-up rule across the account's offers, with per-rule health: enabled, last_fired_at (null = never fired), and the connection's status + error if its ESP credentials broke. ALWAYS call this before set_followup — creating a rule that already exists stacks a duplicate that double-tags every buyer. Also your first stop when the merchant asks why follow-up emails aren't going out.
name: list_followups
title: List follow-up rules
